title: Integers on Grid
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq H, W \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq N \leq \min(2 \times 10^5, HW); 1 \leq r_i \leq H; 1 \leq c_i \leq W; 1 \leq a_i \leq 10^9; i \neq j \Rightarrow (r_i, c_i) \neq (r_j, c_j); All values in input are integers.
